page_title: TOR 1-0 LEC | Torino v Lecce 01/02/2026, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+5' Matteo Prati (Torino) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee. Matteo Prati (Torino) will miss the next game.
90+4' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) hasn't suffered any serious injury which would see him leave the pitch. He's back in the game now.
90+3' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
90+2' Nikola Vlasic receives a short pass from Sandro Kulenovic (Torino), but the opposition's defence thwarts his effort.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
89' Here is a change. Che Adams is going off and Marco Baroni gives the last tactical orders to Alieu Njie (Torino).
89' The manager makes a subsitution with Oumar Ngom (Lecce) coming on for Ylber Ramadani.
88' Lameck Banda (Lecce) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
87' The corner from Alex Sala (Lecce) is hurriedly cleared.
87' Konan Ndri (Lecce) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance. Lecce will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
85' The number of offsides is – 4:1.
83' Lameck Banda (Lecce) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
80' Flag goes up against Lameck Banda (Lecce) and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
79' Lameck Banda (Lecce) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
78' Substitution. Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) makes his way off the pitch and Alex Sala comes on as his replacement.
77' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Riccardo Sottil departs the field of play to be replaced by Konan Ndri (Lecce).
77' Marco Baroni decides to make a substitution. Duvan Zapata will be replaced by Sandro Kulenovic (Torino).
75' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 15:12. The shots on goal statistics – 5:2.

74' Matteo Prati (Torino) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked. The defence just can't clear the ball and a rebound eventually falls to Matteo Prati (Torino) deep inside the box, but his well-hit shot flies just wide of the left post.
73' Guillermo Maripan (Torino) rises highest from the corner to head at goal, but his effort towards the left side of the goal is brilliantly kept out by the goalkeeper.
73' Rafael Obrador (Torino) will take the corner.
72' Matteo Prati (Torino) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but it goes out of play. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
71' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
70' Rafael Obrador (Torino) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Valentino Lazaro.
70' Marco Baroni has decided to substitute Emirhan Ilkhan and he is replaced by Matteo Prati (Torino).
70' Substitution. Faustino Anjorin (Torino) on for Cesare Casadei.
69' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) plays a lovely through ball to Nikola Vlasic, but he can't beat Wladimiro Falcone and loses the ball.

67' Che Adams (Torino) comes close to scoring! He gets the ball inside the box from the resulting corner but his effort goes narrowly wide of the left post. This should be a big warning for the defence.
67' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is about to take a corner kick.
66' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Torino force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
65' Eusebio Di Francesco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lameck Banda (Lecce) replacing Omri Gandelman.
65' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kialonda Gaspar (Lecce) comes onto the pitch for Tiago Gabriel.
64' Duvan Zapata (Torino) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball goes out of play and Lecce will have a goal kick.
62' Santiago Pierotti (Lecce) collects a pass from the flank, looks up and fires in a goal-bound shot from the edge of the box which canons off a defender to safety.
61' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Valentino Lazaro (Torino), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
60' Tiago Gabriel (Lecce) makes it easy for the referee to show him a yellow card.
59' Marcus Pedersen (Torino) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.

58' Alberto Paleari pulls off a fantastic save! Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) attempts to head home after a precise cross into the box. He aims his header towards the top of the net, but the effort is kept out.
58' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
55' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Duvan Zapata (Torino) heads on.
54' Cesare Casadei (Torino) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
53' Good chance! Omri Gandelman laid the ball off to Danilo Veiga (Lecce) inside the box, he ducked inside his man and rifled a shot in at goal that skimmed the top of the bar.
50' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.

49' Duvan Zapata (Torino) latches on to a precise pass and one-on-one with the keeper slams the ball towards the left-hand post. Wladimiro Falcone is alert, though, and leaps like a salmon to deny him.
48' Saul Coco (Torino) sends a long ball forward to Che Adams, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Lecce.
47' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
47' Danilo Veiga (Lecce) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Duvan Zapata (Torino) is adjudged offside.

45+1' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) attempts to threaten the goalkeeper from the free kick on the edge of the box. He produces a stunning blast which only flies inches over the crossbar. It could have been a beautiful goal!
45' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

45' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Nikola Vlasic (Torino) was quite harsh and Simone Sozza didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card. Nikola Vlasic (Torino) will miss the next game because of that yellow card.
45' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul. Lecce win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
44' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) decides to take a short corner instead of crossing into the box.

44' Omri Gandelman (Lecce) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the left side of the goal, but Alberto Paleari was alert and made a comfortable save. Lecce win a corner.
42' A direct free kick from a promising position, taken by Riccardo Sottil (Lecce), is struck into one of the defending players who deals with the threat.
41' Simone Sozza blows his whistle for a foul after Valentino Lazaro (Torino) hacks down one of his opponents. Another situation results in a direct free kick for Lecce.

40' Cesare Casadei (Torino) fashions a shot from the edge of the box after receiving an accurate pass. Wladimiro Falcone makes a stunning save to stop the effort from flying into the left side of the goal. The rebound finds Valentino Lazaro (Torino) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance!
38' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) picks up a rebound, moves into space and fires a shot at goal from long range that rises sharply and goes high over the bar.
38' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
38' Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Lecce will take a corner kick.
35' Duvan Zapata (Torino) hits a thunderbolt of a shot from the edge of the box, but it's a comfortable save for Wladimiro Falcone as it's directed low at the middle of the goal.
32' What a big chance! Duvan Zapata (Torino) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and skies the ball well over the bar.
31' 1:4 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The current number of shots on goal is 1:1.
30' The goal stands! That took a long time for referee Simone Sozza to decide it wasn’t offside. The relieved Torino players can finally celebrate.
30' Wait! Referee Simone Sozza has indicated he is going to review the Torino goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.
29' 1 - 0 Goal! Nikola Vlasic puts a cross into the box and finds Che Adams (Torino), who latches on to it and strikes the ball inside the left post. He makes it 1:0.
28' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) takes the corner with a short pass.

27' Ylber Ramadani (Lecce) gets to the rebound outside the penalty box and unleashes a long-range shot towards the top of the net, Alberto Paleari makes a decent save to stop the effort. The referee and his assistant both point at the corner flag. Lecce will have an opportunity to threaten the opposition's goal.
27' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
27' A defender unwittingly blocks the ball on the line after a snap shot from Lassana Coulibaly (Lecce) inside the box following a slide rule pass. It will be a corner kick for Lecce.
25' The corner kick is deflected to Antonino Gallo (Lecce), who immediately sends in a long-range shot. However, he hits the ball poorly and it goes high over the bar.
25' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.
25' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) steps up to take the corner, but the ball just sails in among the defenders.
24' Riccardo Sottil (Lecce) fails to deliver a cross from the free kick as his attempt is thwarted by the opposition's defence.
23' Emirhan Ilkhan (Torino) makes a slide tackle, but referee Simone Sozza blows for a foul. Lecce earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
21' Walid Cheddira (Lecce) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
19' Good defending. Marcus Pedersen (Torino) tries to find Duvan Zapata inside the box, but the pass is cut out.
17' The ball possession is 71:29.
16' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) is unable to feed an accurate cross into the box.
14' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) sends a long cross over to Cesare Casadei, but Wladimiro Falcone comes forward to gather the ball.
13' Saul Coco (Torino) is able to continue to play.
10' Saul Coco (Torino) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
10' Cesare Casadei (Torino) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Duvan Zapata, but Wladimiro Falcone displays great awareness to stop him.
8' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Cesare Casadei (Torino) offside.
7' Valentino Lazaro (Torino) was standing in a clear offside position, making it an easy call for the linesman.
6' Neat passing move from Lecce in order to create new attacking opportunities.
5' Nikola Vlasic (Torino) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
4' Antonino Gallo (Lecce) sends a long cross over to Walid Cheddira, but Alberto Paleari comes forward to gather the ball.
2' Omri Gandelman (Lecce) attempts to find Riccardo Sottil, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone. The ball goes out of play and Torino will have a goal kick.
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are on the pitch and Torino will have the kick-off.
Simone Sozza will supervise the game today.
